record.name: PrimeArt – AI Photo Editor
record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
One photo. A whole new creative direction.

Turn a selfie into a polished headshot, retro flash portrait, fashion editorial, restored memory, or original AI image. Explore 99 ready-made styles—including 20 new looks inspired by the visual culture of now.

20 NEW LOOKS, MADE FOR NOW

Move from 2016 Retro Flash and Disposable Memory to Y2K Camcorder, 90s Yearbook, Analog Scrapbook, Collectible Mini, Sport-Luxe, Dark Romance, Glacier Blue, Halo Hair, cinematic motion, and original movie-poster scenes.

MAKE IT LOOK LIKE YOU

PrimeArt uses your photo as the foundation for each transformation. Choose a look, add your image, and create a result designed to keep you recognizable while changing the era, setting, mood, styling, or medium.

99 READY-MADE STYLES

No prompt writing required. Browse curated ideas across:

• Portraits and profile pictures
• Professional headshots and studio photos
• Beauty and hair transformations
• Fashion and editorial photoshoots
• Retro film, vintage, and Y2K aesthetics
• Lifestyle and cinematic scenes
• Product campaigns and social-ready visuals
• Creative art and stylized looks

RESTORE AND REIMAGINE

Use dedicated styles to restore and enhance old photos, reduce visible scratches and fading, improve contrast, or add natural-looking color. You can also reinterpret a recent photo in an entirely new visual world.

CREATE FROM WORDS

Already have an idea? Describe the scene, mood, outfit, lighting, and style you want. Start from text, add reference photos when needed, and turn your prompt into an original image.

BUILT FOR EVERY FORMAT

Create square, portrait, landscape, or vertical images for profile pictures, posts, campaigns, concepts, and personal projects.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick a ready-made style or write your own prompt.
2. Add a photo when the selected experience uses one.
3. Choose Standard or Ultra quality.
4. Create, review, save, and share your result.

Your projects stay in your account history, so you can return to previous creations whenever inspiration strikes.

Create the photo you already have in mind—or discover a look you did not know you wanted.

Some styles and generation features require credits, an in-app purchase, or a subscription. Feature availability may vary by device and plan.

record.offering: Photo & Video app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Transform your images with Photoleap, the most powerful photo editing app on the market! Whether you’re an artist, or you just simply love to edit & create, you'll be blown away by all the creative possibilities packed into this sophisticated photo editing app. 

Check out Photoleap's new features!

* AI image generator to create the photos you dream of
* First-in-class AI tools will help you create astounding digital art, just by typing the idea you’re imagining
* Speed up your photo editing with a powerful AI baseline creation that you can work off of & add more photo effects to
* Add motion to your photos! Create live photos with 3D effects.
* New photo animator tools to edit pictures & make your photos come alive with effects and 3D edits. 

Use your AI art creations as the cover art for an album, a selfie background, or just to share with your friends. Go wherever your imagination takes you, & continue to edit your creations with Photoleap’s advanced photo editing tools. 

From layers and blending modes, to photo filters and effects, brushes, fonts, tonal adjustments, film, black and white and duo presets, with Photoleap photo editor, you’ll turn the ideas in your head into brilliant art right on your phone. Unleash your creativity and start transforming photos into works of art.

Creative Combinations
• Superior photo mixing. Superimpose images, create double exposures and surreal iPhone art
• Sophisticated Layers! Combining photos made simple, plus the ability to re-edit each layer at any time
• Photo Blending: Adjust blending modes, transparency, and transform (perspective change) images
• Change the background of your photo with your fingertips

Artistic Masterpieces
• Use the collage maker to collage photos together to tell a story
• Add text to photos, draw, or doodle on your image
• Utilize cool tools to create graphic designs, street art, abstract and contemporary masterpieces
• Use our one of a kind photo filters to set mood
• Set the mood in any season with our sky photo editor 
• Create professional-looking social media posts, flyers or posters for your business
• Have some fun and easily create memes that will keep you laughing
• New packs designed just for you, added all the time: light leaks, filters for pictures, elements, stickers for photos, styles, backdrops, fonts, effects, and brushes.

Image Correction & More
• Masking built-in to nearly every tool, with smart new quick select brushes to save time
• Control & adjust it all: tonality, color, grain, vignette, fade, structure, intensity and much more
• Colorize images and apply beautiful gradients with duo filters
• Quick blemish/object remover to get rid of defects
• Easily resize and crop images while keeping aspect ratios intact
• Blur photos for effect or privacy

Pro Editing
• RAW support
• 16 bit image depth support for high quality tonal adjustments
• You can set the size of your canvas
• Not done editing? Photo sessions are auto-saved, simply continue later

- Privacy policy: https://static.lightricks.com/legal/privacy-policy.pdf

record.name: Niva: AI Photo Editor
record.offering: Photo & Video app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The only photo editor where you just describe what you want.

No sliders, no layers, no tutorials. Niva uses AI to understand plain language and deliver professional edits in seconds. Upload a photo, type your request, and get studio-quality results without learning complex tools.

Trusted by thousands of creators, sellers, and everyday users who want fast, effortless photo editing.

WHAT YOU CAN DO:

• Remove or replace any background — one sentence, done
• Erase unwanted objects, people, or text from any photo
• Create professional product photos for e-commerce listings
• Retouch portraits and selfies with natural, realistic results
• Fix lighting, exposure, shadows, and color balance instantly
• Generate AI headshots and polished profile photos
• Add, swap, or transform objects in any scene
• Apply artistic styles, filters, and creative effects
• Enhance low-quality images to sharp, high-resolution output
• Blur backgrounds for professional depth-of-field look

HOW IT WORKS:

1. Upload any photo from your gallery or camera
2. Type what you want changed — in your own words
3. Niva AI processes your edit in seconds
4. Save in full resolution or share directly

It really is that simple. No watching tutorials, no figuring out which tool does what. Just describe your edit like you would to a friend.

NO EDITING SKILLS NEEDED:

Traditional photo editors have hundreds of buttons and a steep learning curve. Niva replaces all of that with a simple conversation. Just tell Niva what you want — background removed, object erased, lighting fixed, style changed — and the AI handles everything.

You don't need to know what "curves" or "levels" mean. You don't need to learn masking or layer blending. Just type "make the background white" or "remove the person on the left" and it's done.

MADE FOR:

• Social media creators who need fast, scroll-stopping content
• Online sellers who need clean product images without a photographer
• Professionals who want polished headshots and profile photos
• Students and job seekers creating standout application photos
• Small business owners designing marketing visuals on a budget
• Anyone tired of complicated editing apps with features they never use

WORKS LIKE A CHAT:

Think of Niva as your personal photo editing assistant. You describe the result you want, and Niva delivers it. No menus to navigate, no filters to scroll through, no manual adjustments.

Remove a background. Fix the lighting. Change an outfit. Erase a person. Improve a product shot. Add an object. Sharpen a blurry image. Whatever you need — just type it.

EXAMPLES OF WHAT PEOPLE ASK NIVA:

"Remove the background and make it white"
"Make my skin look smoother but keep it natural"
"Remove the person standing behind me"
"Make this look like a professional headshot"
"Fix the lighting — it's too dark"
"Replace the background with a beach scene"

Every edit is processed by AI in seconds. No waiting, no complexity.

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES:

Niva is available in English, Korean, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish. More languages coming soon.

Download now and edit your first photo in under 30 seconds. No subscription required to start.

Welcome to VSCO — your complete photography platform solution for unmatched photo filters, AI photo editing, video editing, portfolio sites, client workflows, and community. VSCO is where photographers turn pro.

Get access to a premium AI photo editor that provides precision and quality. From editing with our photo presets that match your style to delivering stunning client photo galleries, the VSCO photo and video editing app is a seamless way to run your photography business in one place. Download the VSCO app today.

VSCO APP FEATURES:

200+ PHOTO PRESETS AND FILTERS
- Use professional-grade photo filters and editing tools such as Crop and Fade to effortlessly showcase your style.
- Try photo filters that reflect vintage film looks inspired by Kodak, Fuji, Agfa, and others with Film X presets.
- Save and recreate your favorite photo filters and edits with Recipes and join VSCO Membership to access VSCO’s complete library of 200+ photo presets. 

EDIT 100 PHOTOS AT ONCE
- Create the perfect edit and paste it on up to 100 photos. 
- Easily apply photo presets, film effects, and adjustments like exposure, contrast, and white balance to keep your aesthetic consistent. 
- See every change happen in real time, then export when you're done.

ADVANCED PHOTO EDITOR WITH AI LAB
- Experience intelligent AI photo editing designed to enhance without overpowering. 
- Use advanced photo editing tools: HSL, Dodge & Burn, Split Tone, and Grain.  
- Remove distractions, upscale, repair, and refine photos with AI prompts. Included with VSCO Pro membership with unlimited edits.

VIDEO EDITING WITHOUT COMPROMISE
- Featuring trim, crop, speed control, slo-mo, and color grading all in one place.
- Use the same premium VSCO photo presets and advanced photo editor tools for video.
- Easily create short video GIFs with VSCO.

REFINE MOMENTS WITH COLLAGE MAKER
- Make photo and video editing collages in seconds. 
- Create new compositions with photos, text, and customizable shapes using pre-set collage templates or start with a blank canvas. 
- Montage video editing. Easily edit and combine video scenes.

VSCO SPACES
- Spaces are collaborative environments that provide a safe space for creators to workshop ideas, share inspiration, and connect. 
- Create and join community galleries to build relationships to move your work forward.

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
- Create a professional profile that showcases your unique skills. 
- Post photos and videos, organize your work into Albums, and tell stories with Blogs.
- Add your experience and let others know that you're open to collaborating and professional work.

INSPIRED BY COMMUNITY
- Join a community that opens the door to your creativity. 
- Start discussions on posts, repost inspiring photos, and make direct connections with messaging. 
- Curate a feed that captures your unique interests and showcases photographers you follow from around the world.

Explore even more features on desktop at http://vsco.co 

MEMBERSHIP TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION TERMS

Start your VSCO membership with a free 7-day trial. Once the trial is over, you’ll be charged an annual subscription fee. Your VSCO membership will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.

Read more about our terms and conditions here —
http://vsco.co/about/terms_of_use 

Read more about our privacy policy here —
http://vsco.co/about/privacy_policy

【 Enhance Photo Quality 】
Many people ask, “How can I enhance photo quality?”
With PhotoApp's AI Photo Enhancer, you can improve photo quality and clarity with just one tap. You can also enhance recently taken photos for clearer details and better resolution.

PhotoApp helps you sharpen portraits, selfies, and group photos with AI. Reduce blur, improve details, and make out-of-focus pictures clearer with just one tap.

Create realistic AI photos inspired by your own images. Explore different looks and generate high-quality portraits in just a few minutes.

【 Improve Photo Resolution 】
Improve the resolution of your photos and upscale your pictures to HD quality.

【 Colorize and Restore Old Pictures 】
Add color to old black-and-white photos with just one tap. Enhance faded or blurry pictures, improve their clarity, and colorize them to give old memories a refreshed look.

【 Remove Objects 】
Remove unwanted objects, people, or other distractions from your photos in just a few simple steps.

- Remove Background from Images and Photos
- Turn Photos into Cartoon Effects
- Sharpen and Enhance Images
- Restore Old Photos

Gen AI Studio is an all-in-one creative AI studio that turns text prompts and reference images into high-quality images and movie-style videos in minutes — no editing or design skills required.

AI IMAGE GENERATION
• Generate high-fidelity images from text prompts.
• Render clearer, more legible text inside images, with multi-language support.
• Made for posters, thumbnails, product shots, illustrations and branding assets.
• Refine a result and regenerate variations until the details are right.

AI VIDEO GENERATION
• Create cinematic short videos from text or from a still image.
• Animate photos into realistic footage with natural motion.
• Add native audio such as ambience, effects or dialogue (model-dependent).
• Hold lighting, lens feel and pacing steady from one shot to the next.

REFERENCE-BASED CREATION
• Keep characters, products and scenes consistent across generations.
• Match a visual style, from cinematic looks to painterly art.
• Preserve colors, composition and overall creative direction.
• Reuse one reference set so a whole series of posts reads as a single campaign.

ADVANCED CONTROLS
• Camera framing and motion control.
• Object and character motion paths.
• First and last frame transitions.
• Extend a scene into a longer clip.
• Aspect ratios including 9:16 and 16:9.
• Outpainting to expand a visual for any screen.
• Add or remove objects seamlessly.

YOUR CREATIVE LIBRARY
• Save the prompts, styles and presets you want to use again.
• Every render stays in one library, so you can pick up where you left off.
• Export in full quality straight to your photo library.

MODELS AND TECHNOLOGY
The model catalog is delivered dynamically and keeps growing: new image and video engines are added on an ongoing basis, and support for further generation models is coming soon. This app is not an official Google product and is not owned, sponsored or endorsed by Google or Google DeepMind.

PERFECT FOR
Social posts, Reels, Shorts, TikTok, YouTube, UGC ads, promo videos, product demos, explainers, trailers, logo stingers and experimental AI video art.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a model.
2. Enter a prompt and add reference images (optional).
3. Preview duration, aspect ratio and the credits required.
4. Generate and export.

Typical length is 4–12 seconds per generation; stitch multiple clips for longer videos.

TIPS FOR BETTER RESULTS
• Describe the subject, the setting, the lighting and the camera move in one clear sentence.
• Add a reference image whenever a character or product has to stay recognizable.
• Start short to test an idea, then regenerate the version you like at full length.

CREDITS AND PLANS
Each generation costs credits, and the exact amount is shown before you confirm, so nothing is charged by surprise. A subscription refills your credit balance every billing period, and heavier models simply cost more credits per run.

SUBSCRIPTION AND BILLING
Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date, and payment is charged to your Apple ID. Unused credits roll over while your subscription stays active. Refunds are handled by Apple under App Store policies. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

LEGAL
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://media.showsapp.org/assets/geminiPrivacyPolicy.html
Model access is provided via third-party AI services. Not affiliated with Google or Google DeepMind.
